messages:
sophia: Quick postmortem sync 7 GPU capacity/autoscale follow-ups. Listing owners + short timelines. Please ack.

ajay: Ack. Ill own quota backstop + reserve pool sizing.

kenji: Ill take scheduler tuning (preemption thresholds + slow-start).

lina: Ill update runbooks and on-call playbook. ETA Wed EOD.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-8129 (https://tracker.internal/INF-8129). Assigned ajay, kenji, lina. Due 2026-04-08.

sophia: Noted recurring pattern: daily burst around 09:45 UTC causing ~40% headroom dip. Propose: 10-min rolling headroom alert + scheduled warm-pool bump during that window.

ajay: For quota I'll add reserved pool: 8 GPUs, burst 30%. Applying via infra: `kubectl apply -f reserved-pool.yaml`.

kenji: Staging scheduler tweak proposal:
```
preemptionThreshold: 0.65
slowStartMs: 250
bufferGPUs: 2
```

lina: Runbook additions: warmup job, KV priming, sanity query post-scale. PR later today.

sophia: Agree on fallback order: 1) model-variant (smaller), 2) reserved pool, 3) manual capacity add. No cross-tenant re-route by default.

ajay: I'll run 2x synthetic burst validation next Tue morning; kenji can pair?

kenji: I can join. Send invite.

sophia: Thanks all. Weekly checkpoint set Mon 10:00 UTC. Ping if blockers.
